subtopic: Tax Deductions, Tax-Deferred Growth, and Tax-Free Withdrawals
source_evidence: These benefits can include tax deductions (e.g., pre-tax contributions), tax-deferred growth (no taxes until withdrawal), and/or tax-free withdrawals.
answer: Tax-advantaged accounts can offer different kinds of tax benefits. A tax deduction can apply to pre-tax contributions. With tax-deferred growth, taxes are not due until withdrawal. Tax-free withdrawals mean withdrawals are not taxed. An account may offer one or more of these benefits, so the details depend on the account.
